PHASE.NAME: RTK Structured System Adapter Expansion
PHASE.GOAL: Port high-value standalone RTK system adapters where local processing is materially better than proxying raw shell output.

STEPS.step-1: Evaluate and port compact local adapters for summary, smart/read modes, log, pipe, and format flows where they fit Synapse boundaries.
STEPS.step-2: Record adapter-level savings consistently for new local adapters.
